title: cress configuration
description: Schema for a cress site config file (cress.toml): the site metadata and the grouped navigation tables.

site.description: Site-wide metadata shared by every rendered page.

title.description: Site name, shown in the header and page titles.

description.description: Optional site tagline, exposed to templates (e.g. a meta description).

base_url.description: Canonical site root, e.g. "https://example.com". In-site links stay root-relative; this is exposed to templates for absolute links.

theme.description: Theme to render with. Empty resolves to the built-in default theme "cress". Any other name must match a directory under themes/.

logo.description: Path or URL to a logo image rendered in the navigation. Empty means no logo is rendered, unless the theme supplies its own fallback. Typically a file in static/, e.g. "/logo.svg".

logo_dark.description: Path or URL to a logo image for readers who prefer a dark color scheme, replacing logo for them. Unset means logo applies to both. Requires logo: a dark variant cannot stand alone.

favicon.description: Path or URL to a favicon. Empty means no icon link is rendered, unless the theme supplies its own fallback. Typically a file in static/, e.g. "/favicon.png".

accent.description: Accent color used as a highlight (e.g. on links). A CSS hex value. Leave it unset and the theme's own accent applies, including any per-scheme variant it defines.

accent_dark.description: Accent color for readers who prefer a dark color scheme. A CSS hex value; unset means accent applies to both. No single color clears WCAG AA contrast against a light and a dark background at once, so an accent legible in one scheme needs this for the other.

footer.description: Footer message replacing the theme's default cress credit. Plain text: templates escape it, so markup renders as characters rather than as HTML. Empty keeps the credit.

copyright.description: Copyright notice for the footer, e.g. "(c) {year} Cozy Badger". A "{year}" token expands to the year the site was built. Empty omits the notice.

nav.description: Explicit navigation, grouped into the menus a theme renders separately. Both groups are optional.

main.description: Primary menu, rendered in the header.

footer.description: Secondary menu, rendered in the footer: legal pages, social links, and the like.

navGroup.description: One menu, as a table of label -> content file (e.g. Home = "index.md"). Entries appear in the order written.

additionalProperties.description: Content file the entry links to, relative to content/ (e.g. "about.md").
